title: If ordering more than one, beware of dye lot difference
text:
If ordering more than one, beware of dye lot difference. I'd like it a lot better if the dye lot was the same across all quilts. I bought this as a couch protector, so I bought two at first. They looked quite nice on my couch, so I bought two more shortly after of the same color so I would have a set to swap out from when one set gets laundered. The next two were not the exact same color. Where the first two were the exact same chocolate brown, the next two were less brown and more of a reddish brown- and they weren't even the same. The color didn't bother me, but the fact that I now had 4 quilts in 3 different colors when they should have been all the same. At the very least, since I use one on a couch and one on a love seat, if I had two that were the same and other two were same, then it would look ok.
If you are just buying one, then know that it might be chocolate brown, or a reddish brown, or somewhere in between. If buying two, know that they might not be same exact color.
On the plus side: The quilt washes well, there is some shrinkage but not too bad. It is very light weight and even the King size fit in my washer no problem. It is overall attractive and plenty big enough to cover a bed and pillows.
